17 October 2026

A letter to my wheelchair

Dear wheelchair,

I am MSN., your owner. I am writing this letter to tell you about my experience with you. I am writing this letter to tell you about my experience with you. I want to express my deepest gratitude towards you.

I will tell you about my life before you came into it. I usually woke up at 10 am and after breakfast at about 11 am, I would start using my mobile.

On my mobile I would usually binge watch anime series and play some games on my laptop.

I rarely went outside from my bedroom and when I did, I would only go to my brother's room to play games with him.

Then we made a plan to buy you so that I can also enjoy life outside without needing anyone's help.

On a sunny day, we went to the "Nilaa Ghumbad Wheelchair market".We searched multiple stores inorder to find you.

Then in one shop we saw you and we were amazed because you were fulfilling all of our requirements. We negotiated your price from with the seller and we bought you at a reasonable price.

After that, we put you in our car's trunk and came home. I was amazed and happy back then, and i still feel that way because I can experience freedom after a very long time.

Today, at Boba Bash web development event, I am able to come by your help.

Thank you very for taking me everywhere whenever I want.

With heartfelt gratitude,

SHAYAN

A LIFE IN THE PUBLIC EYE

Imran Ahmed
Khan Niazi

From international cricket to philanthropy and national politics, explore the journey of one of Pakistan's most recognised public figures.

Explore His Journey
1952 Born in Lahore
1992 World Cup Victory

A JOURNEY THROUGH HISTORY

THE PERSON BEHIND THE NAME

Biography

A Life Beyond Cricket

Imran Ahmed Khan Niazi was born on 5 October 1952 in Lahore, Pakistan. He first became internationally famous as a cricketer and later became known for his charitable work and political career.

His public life has included sporting achievements, the establishment of healthcare and education initiatives, and leadership in Pakistani politics.

His career has made him a significant and often debated figure in Pakistan's modern history.

THE SPORTING YEARS

A Cricket Legend

A fast bowler, an all-rounder and the captain who led Pakistan to its first Cricket World Cup title.

1971–1992

Leading Pakistan on the World Stage

Imran Khan made his Test debut in 1971 and became one of Pakistan's leading all-rounders. His pace bowling, batting and captaincy helped shape an important era in Pakistani cricket.

In 1992, he captained Pakistan to victory in the Cricket World Cup in Australia and New Zealand. The win remains a defining moment in Pakistan's sporting history.

1992

Cricket World Cup Champions

Pakistan won its first men's Cricket World Cup under his captaincy.

SERVICE AND SOCIAL WORK

Philanthropy

A Focus on Healthcare and Education

After retiring from international cricket, Imran Khan helped establish the Shaukat Khanum Memorial Cancer Hospital and Research Centre, which opened in Lahore in 1994.

The hospital was founded in memory of his mother, Shaukat Khanum, and works to provide cancer treatment, including financial support for patients who cannot afford the full cost.

He also founded Namal, an educational initiative that developed into a university in Mianwali.

A CAREER IN PUBLIC SERVICE

Political Journey

His move from sport and charity into electoral politics reshaped his public career.

1996

Founded Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf

He established PTI and began his formal political career.

2002

Entered the National Assembly

He was elected to Pakistan's National Assembly for the first time.

2013

Expanded Political Support

PTI emerged as a major political force in the general election.

2018

Became Prime Minister

Following the general election, he became Pakistan's 22nd prime minister.

2022

Left Office

He was removed from office after losing a vote of no confidence in the National Assembly.

MOMENTS AND MEMORIES

Photo Gallery

A collection of photographs featuring Imran Ahmed Khan Niazi.

LEARN MORE

Further Reading

the tale of Orpheus and Eurydice

the story itself:

so orpheus was a musician (and a muse's son). he fell in love with eurydice. they got married. but there was some god who liked eurydice. she was in the forest when he went to her. she ran away from him, towards... a snake. the snake bit her aaand she died.

orpheus was sad. he believed eurydice's life ended before her time. he couldnt accept that she was gone. so he travelled to the underworld to get her back. he made his way through the underworld by singing. everyone liked his song.

he went to hades and persephone. obviously no one can just walk in and take back whoever they want to. thats not how the underworld works. but orpheus played a song with his lyre. it was so heartbreaking and beautiful that even hades was moved.

hades allowed orpheus that, fine, he can take eurydice with him. on ONE CONDITION. he will walk in front. she will walk behind him. and he could not turn around to look at her. if he did, he would lose eurydice forever.

orpheus thanked hades and began his journey. he walked. and walked. and walked. but he could not hear the sound of eurydice's footsteps. what if he had been tricked? and she wasnt even there? and he would step outside the underworld only to see she was left behind. or she got hurt on the way.

a few steps from the exit, he turned around.

there's a quote from ovid's metamorphoses:

'Eurydice, dying now a second time, uttered no complaint against her husband. What was there to complain of, but that she had been loved?'

there are so many interpretations of this story. everytime i tell someone the story for the first time, theyre like: "thats so stupid!" and i get sad and idk how to defend him. it's lowk valid to think that. ig. but the people that say "if i was orpheus, i wouldnt turn around" and it just. no. i dont like that.

but most (not all ofc) people who are familiar with the story have agreed that theres no doubt orpheus loved eurydice. the discussion ive seen most people have is "why did he turn around?". some people say it's BECAUSE he loved eurydice. some people say that yes, he loved eurydice, but the reason he turned around was his doubt (in himself) or fear or smth. i love reading people's different views on this. im too tired to get into my own thoughts.

i first read this story in 2022. i was disappounted in the ending. the book i was reading was a collection of greek myths. i just read this one really fast and moved on. since i disliked tragedies, i basically forgot about every story except for the 2 with happy endings. then in 2025, i became obssessed with this story and cry at least once a week thinking about them.

theres a musical called "hadestown" which is a retelling of the story of orpheus and eurydice. it's not exactly the same but the basic plot is. i can yap about it for hours. im a huge fan. the songs are so peak.

Our Recipe Collection

opium on pizza is kinda based as a childhood snack. Welcome to the A2 Digital Kitchen, the only recipe website running on pure spite, stolen Wi-Fi, and a severe lack of sugar. Created by Ali Talal and Abdur Rehman Mazhar, this site is our official culinary sanctuary from the absolute ***** hole of LGS JT. We’ve officially brought you premium local cravings right from the classroom backbenches. While everyone else is stressing over grades, we're actually risking our freedom coding the ultimate food database just to secure free bubble tea. If you hear an alarm go off in the background, don't look back—just grab a whisk, order the boba, and let's start cooking. 🧋🍳💥

Hover your mouse over a card to see the full recipe!

Classic Pepperoni Pizza

A crisp golden crust topped with savory tomato sauce, rich mozzarella, and spicy pepperoni curls.

Time: 35 mins | Difficulty: Easy

✨ HOVER TO REVEAL RECIPE ✨

Ingredients:

  • 1 ball of fresh pizza dough (250g)
  • 1/2 cup premium Italian tomato sauce
  • 1.5 cups shredded low-moisture mozzarella cheese
  • 1/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese
  • 15-20 slices of spicy beef or chicken pepperoni
  • 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil
  • Fresh basil leaves and dried oregano for garnishing
  • A pinch of red chili flakes (optional for heat)

Instructions:

  1. Preheat your kitchen oven to its highest setting, ideally 450°F to 500°F (230°C to 260°C), and lightly grease your pizza pan with olive oil.
  2. Place your fresh dough ball on a lightly floured surface. Use your hands to gently press and stretch it out into a 12-inch round circle, keeping the edges slightly thicker for a crunchy crust.
  3. Transfer the stretched dough onto your prepared baking pan. Ladle 1/2 cup of tomato sauce onto the center and spread it outward in a circular motion, leaving a 1/2-inch border clean around the edge.
  4. Evenly sprinkle the grated Parmesan cheese first, followed by a generous, thick layer of shredded mozzarella cheese over all of the sauce.
  5. Arrange your pepperoni slices evenly across the layer of cheese. Drizzle one tablespoon of extra virgin olive oil lightly over the entire pizza, especially on the exposed dough edges.
  6. Place the pan in your hot oven and bake for 12 to 15 minutes, or until the cheese is completely melted, bubbling, and golden-brown, and the outer crust rim looks beautifully crisp.
  7. Carefully slide the pizza out of the oven. Let it cool down for 2 to 3 minutes, garnish with fresh basil or dried oregano, slice it into equal triangles, and serve fresh!

Chicken Dum Biryani

Fragrant basmati rice layered with juicy marinated chicken, slow-cooked with aromatic traditional spices.

Time: 60 mins | Difficulty: Medium

✨ HOVER TO REVEAL RECIPE ✨

Ingredients:

  • 500g Basmati Rice (washed and soaked for 30 minutes)
  • 500g Chicken pieces (bone-in for maximum flavor)
  • 3 tablespoons Shan Sindhi Biryani Masala (adjust for spice preference)
  • 1 cup fresh yogurt (whisked smoothly)
  • 1 tablespoon ginger paste & 1 tablespoon garlic paste
  • 3 medium onions (finely sliced and fried until crispy golden brown)
  • 2 medium tomatoes (chopped cleanly into cubes)
  • 2 medium potatoes (peeled and cut into halves)
  • 3-4 green chilies (whole or slit vertically)
  • 1/4 cup fresh mint leaves & 1/4 cup chopped coriander
  • 4 tablespoons cooking oil or pure ghee

Instructions:

  1. Heat 4 tablespoons of oil or ghee in a large cooking pot. Add the sliced onions and fry them over medium heat until they turn completely crispy and golden brown. Take out a small handful of onions and save them later for garnishing.
  2. Add the chicken pieces, ginger paste, and garlic paste to the pot. Stir-fry over high heat for 5 minutes until the chicken changes color and becomes lightly sealed.
  3. Stir in the chopped tomatoes, potato halves, whisked yogurt, and 3 tablespoons of Shan Sindhi Biryani Masala. Cover the pot with a tight lid and let it simmer on medium-low heat for 15 to 20 minutes until the potatoes are soft and the chicken is fully cooked through.
  4. While the chicken cooks, bring a separate large pot of water to a rolling boil. Add your soaked Basmati rice and cook it until it is about 70% cooked (the grain should still have a slight snap in the middle). Drain the water completely.
  5. Lower the stove heat of your chicken pot. Layer the drained, warm basmati rice evenly over the top of the cooked chicken masala base. Do not stir or mix them together.
  6. Scatter your fresh mint leaves, chopped coriander, green chilies, and the saved golden fried onions evenly across the top layer of rice. Drizzle your saffron-infused milk over the top for color.
  7. Cover the pot tightly with a lid (you can wrap the lid in a clean kitchen towel to seal the steam). Let it cook on ultra-low heat ("Dum") for 10 to 15 minutes until steam builds up and the rice grains are perfectly fluffy and tender. Mix gently from the bottom before serving!

Ultimate Signature Smash Burgers

Crispy, thin smashed beef patties with seared edges, melted American cheese, fresh toppings, and special secret sauce in a toasted bun.

Time: 20 mins | Difficulty: Medium

🍔 HOVER TO REVEAL SECRET FORMULA 🍔

Ingredients:

  • 200g ground beef (80/20 fat blend divided into two balls)
  • 2 slices of yellow American cheese
  • 2 soft potato burger buns
  • 1 tablespoon butter
  • Salt and black pepper to taste
  • Secret Sauce: 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tbsp ketchup, 1 tsp yellow mustard, 1 tsp sweet pickle relish
  • Toppings: 4 crispy pickle slices, 2 thin slices of fresh tomato, shredded iceberg lettuce, 2 thin rings of red onion

Instructions:

  1. Prepare the secret sauce in a small bowl by mixing the mayonnaise, ketchup, mustard, and sweet pickle relish until smooth. Set aside.
  2. Slice the potato buns in half and spread butter on the cut sides. Toast them on a warm pan until golden brown and set aside.
  3. Heat a heavy cast-iron skillet or flat griddle on high heat until it gets smoking hot.
  4. Place the beef balls onto the dry, hot skillet and press down immediately using a heavy flat burger press or spatula until completely flat and thin.
  5. Season the beef patties generously with salt and black pepper. Cook undisturbed for 2 minutes until the bottom edges are dark brown and very crispy.
  6. Carefully scrape and flip the patties over. Immediately place a yellow American cheese slice on each patty and cook for 1 more minute until melted.
  7. Spread a generous layer of the secret sauce on the bottom bun. Layer the shredded lettuce, tomato slices, onion rings, and pickles on top.
  8. Stack the two cheesy smashed beef patties on top of the fresh vegetable layer, cover with the top bun, and enjoy immediately!

Decadent New York Cheesecake

A rich, dense, and creamy baked cheesecake slice sitting on a sweet, buttery graham cracker crust.

Time: 50 mins | Difficulty: Hard

🍰 HOVER TO REVEAL SECRET FORMULA 🍰

Ingredients:

  • 1.5 cups crushed graham crackers or biscuits
  • 4 tablespoons melted butter
  • 3 packs (total 600g) cream cheese at room temperature
  • 1 cup white sugar
  • 3 large eggs
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions:

  1. Mix the biscuit crumbs with melted butter and press firmly into the base of a springform pan.
  2. Beat the cream cheese and sugar together in a large mixing bowl until perfectly smooth and creamy.
  3. Add the eggs one at a time, followed by the vanilla extract, blending gently on low speed.
  4. Pour the filling over the crust base and bake at 325°F (160°C) for 45 minutes until the center sets.

Ooey Gooey Fudge Brownies

Rich, dense chocolate brownies featuring crisp crinkle tops and sweet, chewy fudge centers.

Time: 25 mins | Difficulty: Easy

🍫 HOVER TO REVEAL SECRET FORMULA 🍫

Ingredients:

  • 1 cup melted unsalted butter
  • 2 cups white sugar
  • 4 large eggs
  • 1 cup all-purpose flour
  • 1 cup unsweetened cocoa powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt

Instructions:

Our Recipe Collection

opium on pizza is kinda based as a childhood snack. Welcome to the A2 Digital Kitchen, the only recipe website running on pure spite, stolen Wi-Fi, and a severe lack of sugar. Created by Ali Talal and Abdur Rehman Mazhar, this site is our official culinary sanctuary from the absolute ***** hole of LGS JT. We’ve officially brought you premium local cravings right from the classroom backbenches. While everyone else is stressing over grades, we're actually risking our freedom coding the ultimate food database just to secure free bubble tea. If you hear an alarm go off in the background, don't look back—just grab a whisk, order the boba, and let's start cooking. 🧋🍳💥

Hover your mouse over a card to see the full recipe!

Classic Pepperoni Pizza

A crisp golden crust topped with savory tomato sauce, rich mozzarella, and spicy pepperoni curls.

Time: 35 mins | Difficulty: Easy

✨ HOVER TO REVEAL RECIPE ✨

Ingredients:

  • 1 ball of fresh pizza dough (250g)
  • 1/2 cup premium Italian tomato sauce
  • 1.5 cups shredded low-moisture mozzarella cheese
  • 1/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese
  • 15-20 slices of spicy beef or chicken pepperoni
  • 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil
  • Fresh basil leaves and dried oregano for garnishing
  • A pinch of red chili flakes (optional for heat)

Instructions:

  1. Preheat your kitchen oven to its highest setting, ideally 450°F to 500°F (230°C to 260°C), and lightly grease your pizza pan with olive oil.
  2. Place your fresh dough ball on a lightly floured surface. Use your hands to gently press and stretch it out into a 12-inch round circle, keeping the edges slightly thicker for a crunchy crust.
  3. Transfer the stretched dough onto your prepared baking pan. Ladle 1/2 cup of tomato sauce onto the center and spread it outward in a circular motion, leaving a 1/2-inch border clean around the edge.
  4. Evenly sprinkle the grated Parmesan cheese first, followed by a generous, thick layer of shredded mozzarella cheese over all of the sauce.
  5. Arrange your pepperoni slices evenly across the layer of cheese. Drizzle one tablespoon of extra virgin olive oil lightly over the entire pizza, especially on the exposed dough edges.
  6. Place the pan in your hot oven and bake for 12 to 15 minutes, or until the cheese is completely melted, bubbling, and golden-brown, and the outer crust rim looks beautifully crisp.
  7. Carefully slide the pizza out of the oven. Let it cool down for 2 to 3 minutes, garnish with fresh basil or dried oregano, slice it into equal triangles, and serve fresh!

Chicken Dum Biryani

Fragrant basmati rice layered with juicy marinated chicken, slow-cooked with aromatic traditional spices.

Time: 60 mins | Difficulty: Medium

✨ HOVER TO REVEAL RECIPE ✨

Ingredients:

  • 500g Basmati Rice (washed and soaked for 30 minutes)
  • 500g Chicken pieces (bone-in for maximum flavor)
  • 3 tablespoons Shan Sindhi Biryani Masala (adjust for spice preference)
  • 1 cup fresh yogurt (whisked smoothly)
  • 1 tablespoon ginger paste & 1 tablespoon garlic paste
  • 3 medium onions (finely sliced and fried until crispy golden brown)
  • 2 medium tomatoes (chopped cleanly into cubes)
  • 2 medium potatoes (peeled and cut into halves)
  • 3-4 green chilies (whole or slit vertically)
  • 1/4 cup fresh mint leaves & 1/4 cup chopped coriander
  • 4 tablespoons cooking oil or pure ghee

Instructions:

  1. Heat 4 tablespoons of oil or ghee in a large cooking pot. Add the sliced onions and fry them over medium heat until they turn completely crispy and golden brown. Take out a small handful of onions and save them later for garnishing.
  2. Add the chicken pieces, ginger paste, and garlic paste to the pot. Stir-fry over high heat for 5 minutes until the chicken changes color and becomes lightly sealed.
  3. Stir in the chopped tomatoes, potato halves, whisked yogurt, and 3 tablespoons of Shan Sindhi Biryani Masala. Cover the pot with a tight lid and let it simmer on medium-low heat for 15 to 20 minutes until the potatoes are soft and the chicken is fully cooked through.
  4. While the chicken cooks, bring a separate large pot of water to a rolling boil. Add your soaked Basmati rice and cook it until it is about 70% cooked (the grain should still have a slight snap in the middle). Drain the water completely.
  5. Lower the stove heat of your chicken pot. Layer the drained, warm basmati rice evenly over the top of the cooked chicken masala base. Do not stir or mix them together.
  6. Scatter your fresh mint leaves, chopped coriander, green chilies, and the saved golden fried onions evenly across the top layer of rice. Drizzle your saffron-infused milk over the top for color.
  7. Cover the pot tightly with a lid (you can wrap the lid in a clean kitchen towel to seal the steam). Let it cook on ultra-low heat ("Dum") for 10 to 15 minutes until steam builds up and the rice grains are perfectly fluffy and tender. Mix gently from the bottom before serving!

Ultimate Signature Smash Burgers

Crispy, thin smashed beef patties with seared edges, melted American cheese, fresh toppings, and special secret sauce in a toasted bun.

Time: 20 mins | Difficulty: Medium

🍔 HOVER TO REVEAL SECRET FORMULA 🍔

Ingredients:

  • 200g ground beef (80/20 fat blend divided into two balls)
  • 2 slices of yellow American cheese
  • 2 soft potato burger buns
  • 1 tablespoon butter
  • Salt and black pepper to taste
  • Secret Sauce: 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tbsp ketchup, 1 tsp yellow mustard, 1 tsp sweet pickle relish
  • Toppings: 4 crispy pickle slices, 2 thin slices of fresh tomato, shredded iceberg lettuce, 2 thin rings of red onion

Instructions:

  1. Prepare the secret sauce in a small bowl by mixing the mayonnaise, ketchup, mustard, and sweet pickle relish until smooth. Set aside.
  2. Slice the potato buns in half and spread butter on the cut sides. Toast them on a warm pan until golden brown and set aside.
  3. Heat a heavy cast-iron skillet or flat griddle on high heat until it gets smoking hot.
  4. Place the beef balls onto the dry, hot skillet and press down immediately using a heavy flat burger press or spatula until completely flat and thin.
  5. Season the beef patties generously with salt and black pepper. Cook undisturbed for 2 minutes until the bottom edges are dark brown and very crispy.
  6. Carefully scrape and flip the patties over. Immediately place a yellow American cheese slice on each patty and cook for 1 more minute until melted.
  7. Spread a generous layer of the secret sauce on the bottom bun. Layer the shredded lettuce, tomato slices, onion rings, and pickles on top.
  8. Stack the two cheesy smashed beef patties on top of the fresh vegetable layer, cover with the top bun, and enjoy immediately!

A rich, dense, and creamy baked cheesecake slice sitting on a sweet, buttery graham cracker crust.

Time: 50 mins | Difficulty: Hard

🍰 HOVER TO REVEAL SECRET FORMULA 🍰

  • 1.5 cups crushed graham crackers or biscuits
  • 4 tablespoons melted butter
  • 3 packs (total 600g) cream cheese at room temperature
  • 1 cup white sugar
  • 3 large eggs
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions:

  1. Mix the biscuit crumbs with melted butter and press firmly into the base of a springform pan.
  2. Beat the cream cheese and sugar together in a large mixing bowl until perfectly smooth and creamy.
  3. Add the eggs one at a time, followed by the vanilla extract, blending gently on low speed.
  4. Pour the filling over the crust base and bake at 325°F (160°C) for 45 minutes until the center sets.
